findings.summary: The task transport has one agent-facing representation: TaskEpisodeView. source_task is not assigned to RunnerContextBundle.task or AgentWorkOrderV2.task, and focused transport/serialization tests cover the removed legacy fields.
findings.broken_invariant: Compatibility evaluator facade requires independent review evidence.

findings.summary: Required-section handling is explicit: oversized required content fails with E_VALIDATION, absent/empty required content emits a typed omission, and configured non-English headings are prioritized structurally.
findings.broken_invariant: Compatibility evaluator facade requires independent review evidence.

hidden_assumptions: The active task-document schema is the only available structural source; the current blueprint contract does not yet author per-role section metadata.
